claim: Stem: 'declared bankrupt in August 2004 under new president Aurelio De Laurentiis'. q: Which iconic Italian club was declared bankrupt in August 2004 under new president Aurelio De Laurentiis, starting from Serie C1 before climbing back to Serie A?

claim: Stem says Genoa won "the first-ever Serie A title in 1898". Serie A did not exist until 1929-30 — the 1898 competition was the Campionato Italiano di Football (a one-day tournament in Turin). The first actual Serie A title (1929-30) was won by Ambrosiana-Inter, which is one of the four options, so a well-informed player can reasonably pick Inter and be marked wrong. Fix by saying "the first-ever Italian championship in 1898".
q: Which Italian club won the first-ever Serie A title in 1898?

q: Which La Liga season did Messi score 50 league goals — breaking his own record?
